Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents:
Try something different:

Year 4 of Street Fighter 6 is now live as the game dates back to 2023 when it first released. Yasmine is the first fighter available in Year 4, with three more coming down the road. Much like the other character releases, there will be four per year. Yasmine is available now for player who own or purchase the Year 4 Character Pass or Year 4 Ultimate Pass. There is also a special Street Voter to commemorate the release of Year 4. The theme is "Your Favorite Genma"! There is a gameplay trailer for Yasmine that can be viewed below.

Details About the Character, Yasmine

Yasmine learned the art of Eskrima alongside her Kuya (older brother) with the guidance of her grandfather, Lolo. Yasmine is new to the series as she hails from the Philippines. She is a fast character and comes with a Karambit knife. Her story involves locating that lost brother who helped her learn the art. Yasmine joins Jamie, Kimberly, Marisa, Manon, Lily, JP, A.K.I., Arjun and Bosch as new characters to the series.

Yasmine is new to the series as she hails from the Philippines.

Yasmine's Outfit 1 showcases the Eskrima combat attire while the Outfit 2 features Yasmine in a school uniform. Outfit 2 gets unlocked by maxing out her Acquisition Gauge in Avatar Arcade Mode or with Fighter Coins. While she is fast in combat, Yasmine is also very aggressive and more acrobatic in her move set. Successfully pulling off moves will place Yasmine in an amped state known as Bayani Mode.

Street Fighter 6 Year 4 Update and Plans

Yasmine is the first content to come in Year 4. The roster will include another newcomer, Arjun, Bosch and finally Tifa from the Final Fantasy VII Remake Series. Tifa is yet another crossover for the game, but this crossover comes from a game that isn't a fighting game. Many requested Tifa for Tekken 8, but it was Capcom who took advantage of the idea and made it happen for Street Fighter 6. This release brings Balance Battle adjustments for the entire roster.

Coming on August 7 is a collaboration event between Onimusha and Street Fighter 6. The Way of the Oni x The Way of the Fist is a collaboration event where all players who log into the game will receive special colors. The Battle Hub will also get an Onimusha-inspired makeover. Onimusha: Way of the Sword had its release date pushed up from September 25 to September 4.

Street Fighter 6 Year 4 DLC Characters

  • Yasmine
  • Tifa
  • Arjun
  • Bosch

​​​​​​​More on the State of Street Fighter 6

Street Fighter 6 released in June 2023 and has received four DLC packs as of August 2026. The game has sold seven million units since launch across Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4|5, PC and Nintendo Switch 2. The next evolution of the Street Fighter series was the first major release in the series since 2016 with Street Fighter 5. Three game modes make up Street Fighter 6: Fighting Ground, World Tour and Battle Hub.

Street Fighter 6 DLC has reintroduced legendary characters, introduced brand new characters, and brought over characters from other games. Terry Bogard, Mai Shiranui and Tifa Lockhart are from other games. Characters returning from the series in Street Fighter 6 DLC include Rashid and Ed from Street Fighter V, Elena and Alex from Street Fighter 3, Crimson Viper from Street Fighter 4, and M. Bison, Akuma and Sagat from the long series lore. Purchasing the Street Fighter 6 Character Ultimate Pass will provide access to all 31 playable characters and the final total of 34.
